About this item

  • Use over 50,000 shades of warm to cool white light to put you in the mood to work, play, or relax — no matter what time of day it is. Start your morning off on the right foot with cool, energising bright white light, or settle down for the night with golden tones.
  • There’s no limit with Philips Hue: with over 16 million colours, you can transform your home into the perfect party venue, bring a bedtime story to life and much more. Use preset, coloured light scenes to evoke the feeling of summer any time you'd like, or use your own photo to relive a special memory.
  • The Philips Hue app gives you complete control over your lights, even if you're not at home. Switch your lights off and on remotely using just the app to ensure your home is always lit the way you want it.
  • With the Hue Sync app and the Hue Bridge, you can bring your entertainment to new heights. Surround yourself with Philips Hue lights and turn on your film, music or game, and then watch your lights mirror the colours and rhythm.
  • The Hue Bridge is an essential component to a personal Philips Hue smart lighting system. It is the brains of the operation, communicating with both your smart light lamps and the Hue app to ensure that everything works together. It also enables smart home automation features like scheduling routines and timers.
  • When connected to the Hue Bridge, you can pair your lights with Alexa, Apple HomeKit, and the Google Assistant and control your lights using just your voice. Simple voice commands let you turn your lights on and off, dim or brighten your lights, and even set a light scene.

Product description

Product Description

Play with light and choose from 16 million colours to instantly change the look and atmosphere of your room. Set the scene effortlessly with one touch of a button. Use a favourite photo and relive that special moment with splashes of light. Includes a Philips Hue colour bulb and experience good quality white and coloured light. Note: Please ensure that on the Hue App, the bulbs are on full brightness.

Box Contains

2 x White and Colour Ambiance B22 Twin Pack + 1 x Hue Bridge
